description_en: Issues Cloud Assistant commands to persistent sessions in WUYING Workspace delivery groups, supports batch issuance to a single delivery group or multiple delivery groups in the same region, and returns the command execution ID
description_zh: 在无影工作站交付组的持久会话上下发云助手命令，支持单个交付组或同地域多个交付组批量下发，返回命令执行ID
kebab_example: aliyun appstream-center run-app-instance-command --product-type WuyingServer --command-type CloudAssistantCmd --command-content 'echo hello' --api-version 2021-09-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RunAppInstanceCommand

parameters.help_en: The product type. Currently, only WuyingServer (WUYING Workspace) is supported. Specifying other values returns a parameter error
parameters.help_zh: 产品类型。目前仅支持 WuyingServer（无影工作站），传入其他值返回参数错误
parameters.name: product_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the delivery group, which is used to execute commands in a single delivery group. You can call [ListAppInstanceGroup](~~ListAppInstanceGroup~~) to obtain the ID. This parameter is required if AppInstanceGroupIds is not specified. Otherwise, a parameter error is returned. This parameter does not take effect if AppInstanceGroupIds is specified
parameters.help_zh: 交付组ID，用于在单个交付组内执行命令。可调用 [ListAppInstanceGroup](~~ListAppInstanceGroup~~) 获取。未指定 AppInstanceGroupIds 时必须指定本参数，否则返回参数错误；同时指定 AppInstanceGroupIds 时本参数不生效
parameters.name: app_instance_group_id

parameters.help_en: The list of delivery group IDs, which is used to issue commands in batches to multiple delivery groups in the same region. The commands are executed on all persistent sessions in each delivery group in the list, and only one command execution ID is returned. A maximum of 100 delivery group IDs are supported, and duplicate IDs are deduplicated. All delivery groups must belong to the same region. Otherwise, InvalidRegion.NotMatch is returned. If any delivery group does not exist, InvalidAppInstanceGroup.NotFound is returned. When this parameter is specified, AppInstanceGroupId and AppInstancePersistentIds do not take effect
parameters.help_zh: 交付组ID列表，用于向同一地域内的多个交付组批量下发命令，命令将在列表内各交付组的全部持久会话上执行，且只返回一个命令执行ID。最多支持 100 个交付组ID，重复的ID会被去重。所有交付组必须属于同一地域，否则返回 InvalidRegion.NotMatch；任一交付组不存在时返回 InvalidAppInstanceGroup.NotFound。指定本参数时，AppInstanceGroupId 和 AppInstancePersistentIds 不生效
parameters.name: app_instance_group_ids

parameters.help_en: The ID of the persistent session, which is used to select a single persistent session in the delivery group specified by AppInstanceGroupId to execute commands. The session must belong to the specified delivery group. Otherwise, an error is returned
parameters.help_zh: 持久会话ID，用于在 AppInstanceGroupId 指定的交付组内选定单个持久会话执行命令。该会话必须属于指定的交付组，否则返回错误
parameters.name: app_instance_persistent_id

parameters.help_en: The command type. Currently, only CloudAssistantCmd (Cloud Assistant command) is supported. Specifying other values returns a parameter error
parameters.help_zh: 命令类型。目前仅支持 CloudAssistantCmd（云助手命令），传入其他值返回参数错误
parameters.name: command_type

parameters.help_en: The command description, which is used to describe the purpose of the issued command for subsequent identification
parameters.help_zh: 命令说明，用于描述本次下发命令的用途，便于后续识别
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The command content, which is the script content executed in the session. It must match the script type specified by RunScriptType
parameters.help_zh: 命令内容，即在会话中执行的脚本内容，需与 RunScriptType 指定的脚本类型匹配
parameters.name: command_content

parameters.help_en: The command parameters, which are passed through to the session execution end along with the command content. Whether to pass them and the specific format depend on the command content. You can leave this parameter empty if it is not required
parameters.help_zh: 命令参数，随命令内容一并透传至会话执行端。是否需要传入以及具体格式取决于命令内容，不需要时可不传
parameters.name: command_param

parameters.help_en: The list of persistent session IDs, which is used to select multiple persistent sessions in the delivery group specified by AppInstanceGroupId to execute commands. A maximum of 100 IDs are supported. This parameter does not take effect when AppInstanceGroupIds is specified, and the commands are executed on all persistent sessions in each delivery group
parameters.help_zh: 持久会话ID列表，用于在 AppInstanceGroupId 指定的交付组内选定多个持久会话执行命令，最多支持 100 个。指定 AppInstanceGroupIds 时本参数不生效，命令将在各交付组的全部持久会话上执行
parameters.name: app_instance_persistent_ids

parameters.help_en:
The type of the script to execute. Valid values:
RunBatScript: bat script
RunPowerShellScript: PowerShell script
RunShellScript: shell script
RunAIAgentScript: AI Agent script
parameters.help_zh:
执行脚本类型。取值：
RunBatScript：Bat 脚本。
RunPowerShellScript：PowerShell 脚本。
RunShellScript：Shell 脚本。
RunAIAgentScript：AI Agent 脚本
parameters.name: run_script_type

parameters.help_en: The timeout period for command execution, in seconds. Default value: 60
parameters.help_zh: 命令执行的超时时长，单位为秒。不传时默认为 60 秒
parameters.name: timeout

InvocationId.description_en: The command execution ID. Only one execution ID is returned even when commands are issued in batches to multiple delivery groups. You can use this ID to call ListCommandInvocationResults to query the command execution results on each session
InvocationId.description_zh: 命令执行ID。批量下发到多个交付组时也只返回一个执行ID，可使用该ID调用 ListCommandInvocationResults 查询各会话上的命令执行结果
